user.title: Sign in to E-Distribuzione
user.description: Signing in from the browser is recommended: you sign in on E-Distribuzione's official website, which the block on automated access does not stop, and your password does not go through Home Assistant. Otherwise you can sign in with password and OTP code.{pod_correnti}

password_login.title: Sign in with password and OTP
password_login.description: Use the credentials from the official E-Distribuzione app or website. After signing in you will be asked for an OTP code sent by email or SMS. If you have the app or website open, log out there first: E-Distribuzione limits concurrent sessions.{pod_correnti}

antibot.title: Automated sign-in blocked
antibot.description: E-Distribuzione did not accept the automated sign-in: it answered with the anti-bot check or with a generic "Technical error". It does not depend on your credentials. You can sign in from the browser, which this block does not stop, or go back to password sign-in and try again later.

browser_login.title: Sign in from the browser
browser_login.description:
Sign in to E-Distribuzione from your browser and paste here the address it ends on. Your password does not go through Home Assistant.{pod_correnti}

1. On a computer, open [E-Distribuzione's website]({login_url}) and sign in with the account of your PODs, OTP code included, until you are in the customer area. If the browser is already signed in with another account, sign out first; if it is signed in with the right one, go to step 2. Do not use a phone with the E-Distribuzione app: the app would open the final address.
2. In the same window, open [the authorization link]({authorization_url}). The page stays blank or shows an error: that is expected, the final address is meant for the app.
3. Copy that address, which starts with `eneldist://redirect`. In Chrome and Edge open the developer tools (F12, or ⌥⌘J on a Mac) and copy from the Console tab the red line that contains it; in other browsers it may show in the address bar. You can paste the whole line.
4. Paste it below and submit. The authorization link only works for this setup.

data_description.redirect_url: The address starting with eneldist://redirect, or the whole console line that contains it.

otp.title: OTP code
otp.description: Enter the OTP code you received by email or SMS. {avviso}

data.richiedi_nuovo_codice: Request a new code (leave the field above empty)

pod.title: Select POD
pod.description: You can select more than one POD if you want to monitor several of them with this same setup.

error.invalid_auth: E-Distribuzione rejected the email or password ("{messaggio}"). Make sure you use the credentials of the E-Distribuzione customer area, the grid operator, not those of your energy supplier (for example Enel Energia): they are two different accounts. If the same credentials work on the official website, try again in a few minutes.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant cannot reach E-Distribuzione. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and DNS, then try again.
error.invalid_otp: Wrong or expired OTP code. It must be the code sent by this setup: one generated on the website or in the app belongs to another login session and is always rejected.
error.otp_mancante: Enter the OTP code, or tick "Request a new code" to have a new one sent
error.troppe_sessioni: E-Distribuzione refused the login because the account has too many concurrent sessions open. Log out of the official app and website, wait a few minutes and try again: in this state no OTP code is sent.
error.accesso_bloccato: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check, so the integration cannot sign in. It does not depend on your credentials: try again later, without insisting.
error.account_bloccato: E-Distribuzione reports that the account is locked or disabled ("{messaggio}"). Sign in on the official website to unlock it, for example by resetting the password, then try again here.
error.password_scaduta: E-Distribuzione reports that the password has expired ("{messaggio}"). Change it on the official website, then sign in here with the new one.
error.login_rifiutato: E-Distribuzione refused the sign-in with this message: "{messaggio}". If it is not clear what to do, open an issue on GitHub quoting the message.
error.app_bloccata: E-Distribuzione is rejecting the official app's client the integration uses to sign in ("app_blocked" answer). It does not depend on your credentials and insisting now does not help: try again later.
error.risposta_inattesa: E-Distribuzione gave an unexpected answer during sign-in ({messaggio}). It does not depend on your credentials: the portal may be under maintenance or may have changed. Try again later; if it keeps happening, open an issue on GitHub with the log attached.
error.errore_imprevisto: Unexpected error during sign-in ({messaggio}). The details are in the Home Assistant log: try again, and if it happens again open an issue on GitHub with the log attached.
error.otp_formato: The OTP code is made of digits only: check that you copied all of it, with no letters.
error.browser_url_mancante: The pasted text contains no address starting with eneldist://redirect. Copy the one shown after signing in, not the link on this page.
error.browser_negato: E-Distribuzione refused the authorization ("{messaggio}"). Open the authorization link again; if it happens again, try later.
error.browser_altro_link: The pasted address belongs to another sign-in link, for example from an earlier attempt. Open the authorization link on this page and paste the address you get.
error.browser_token_mancanti: The pasted address is missing some data ({messaggio}): it was probably only partly copied. Copy all of it, to the end of the line.

abort.no_pods_found: No POD found for this account
abort.supplies_failed: Unexpected error while retrieving the PODs from the account. Start the setup again from the beginning (login and OTP included).
abort.otp_exchange_failed: The OTP code was accepted but completing the login failed. Start the setup again from the beginning (login and OTP included).
abort.accesso_bloccato: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check, so the integration cannot sign in. It does not depend on your credentials: try again later, without insisting.
abort.app_bloccata: After the OTP code, E-Distribuzione rejected the official app's client the integration uses to sign in ("app_blocked" answer). It does not depend on your credentials or on the code: try the setup again later.
abort.account_diverso: The new sign-in is for another E-Distribuzione account: none of this setup's PODs ({pods}) is on that account. Sign out of the portal in the browser, then try again with the right account.

tipo_pod.title: Meter type per POD
tipo_pod.description: A+/A- describe what E-Distribuzione measures (consumption/injection): both are always fetched for every POD. The type below only describes the role of that meter in your system, and only changes the names shown in the Energy Dashboard. You can change it at any time, no new import needed.

aggiungi_pod.title: Add POD
aggiungi_pod.description: PODs currently configured: {pod_correnti}. Below are the ones available on your account that are not yet part of this setup.

rimuovi_pod.title: Remove POD
rimuovi_pod.description: Select the PODs to remove. Historical data already imported into the external statistics is not deleted.

orario.title: Request time
orario.description: Local hour (0-23) from which to request the previous day's curve. Current: {ora_attuale}:00.

error.non_puoi_rimuoverli_tutti: You cannot remove all PODs from here: remove the integration itself if you want to empty it completely

abort.nessun_pod: There are no configured PODs to remove
abort.nessun_pod_selezionato: Select at least one POD to add
abort.nessun_pod_da_aggiungere: All the PODs on your account are already configured here
abort.refresh_failed: Unable to renew access to E-Distribuzione ({errore}). Try again later.
abort.supplies_failed: Unexpected error while retrieving the PODs from the account. Try again later.
abort.accesso_bloccato: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check, so the integration cannot sign in. It does not depend on your credentials: try again later, without insisting.
abort.app_bloccata: E-Distribuzione is rejecting the official app's client the integration uses to sign in ("app_blocked" answer). It does not depend on your credentials: try again later.
abort.accesso_scaduto: Access to E-Distribuzione has expired. Sign in again from the notice in Settings > Devices & services: PODs, options and history are kept.

recupera_storico.name: Fetch history
recupera_storico.description: Requests both energy directions (consumption and injection) for a past period from E-Distribuzione and imports them, with a single request per direction for the whole period (confirmed to work for up to 181 days in one response). History is not fetched automatically: you decide when and how much to fetch. For longer periods, repeat the action over consecutive ranges.

device_id.name: Setup / POD
device_id.description: Choose the device to fetch history for. The "E-Distribuzione" (account) device fetches all the PODs of the setup together; a single POD's device limits the fetch to that POD.

data_da.name: Start date
data_da.description: First day of the period to fetch, as year-month-day (for example 2026-08-01).

data_a.name: End date
data_a.description: Last day of the period to fetch, as year-month-day. Data is available with a one-day delay, so yesterday at the latest.

configura_energy_dashboard.name: Configure Energy Dashboard
configura_energy_dashboard.description: Adds the statistics of all configured PODs to the Energy Dashboard, according to the role assigned to each one (exchange -> grid source, production -> solar source). Idempotent action: it does not overwrite or duplicate sources that already exist (including those configured by hand), safe to run again after adding a POD or changing a role.

dispositivo_non_trovato.message: No device with ID "{device_id}". Pick it from the menu in UI mode, or copy the ID from the address of the device page, after /config/devices/device/. E-Distribuzione devices: {disponibili}.

dispositivo_senza_configurazione.message: The E-Distribuzione setup of the device "{nome}" is not active: usually its last start could not sign in to E-Distribuzione. Check Settings > Devices & services > E-Distribuzione: there you find the reason and, if needed, the button to sign in again.

pod_non_configurato.message: POD '{pod}' is not configured on this instance. Configured PODs: {pods}.

date_invertite.message: The start date ({data_da}) is after the end date ({data_a}): you probably swapped them. Use data_da: "{data_a}" and data_a: "{data_da}".

data_fine_troppo_recente.message: The end date ({data_a}) is too recent: E-Distribuzione publishes data with a one-day delay, so today you can go up to {ultimo_utile} at most. Use data_a: "{ultimo_utile}".

intervallo_troppo_ampio.message: The period from {data_da} to {data_a} is {giorni} days long: a single run covers {massimo} at most (about 6 months). Split it into several runs, the first one for example from {data_da} to {fine_prima_parte}.

nessun_dato_importato.message: No data imported for the period {data_da} - {data_a}. {dettagli}

refresh_token_fallito.message: Unable to renew access to E-Distribuzione ({errore}). The integration retries on its own at the next update.

errore_import_pod.message: POD {pod} was not updated: {errore}. The missing days are requested again at the next update.

accesso_bloccato.message: E-Distribuzione is currently blocking automated access with an anti-bot check. Consumption data will update again as soon as access is available.

dispositivo_mancante.message: Choose the device (device_id field). E-Distribuzione devices: {disponibili}.

un_solo_dispositivo.message: Choose a single device: the "E-Distribuzione" one already fetches all the PODs of the setup. E-Distribuzione devices: {disponibili}.

dispositivo_e_un_entita.message: "{device_id}" is an entity ID, not a device ID. Use the device ID: {disponibili}.

dispositivo_e_un_pod.message: "{valore}" is the POD code, not the device ID. For this POD use device_id: {device_id}

dispositivo_altra_integrazione.message: The device "{nome}" does not belong to the E-Distribuzione integration. E-Distribuzione devices: {disponibili}.

campo_sconosciuto.message: Unknown field: {campi}. The action only accepts device_id, data_da (start date) and data_a (end date).

data_da_mancante.message: The start date is missing (data_da field).

data_a_mancante.message: The end date is missing (data_a field).

data_da_non_valida.message: The start date (data_da) "{valore}" is not valid. Write it as year-month-day, for example data_da: "{esempio}".

data_a_non_valida.message: The end date (data_a) "{valore}" is not valid. Write it as year-month-day, for example data_a: "{esempio}".

data_inizio_troppo_recente.message: The start date ({data_da}) is too recent: E-Distribuzione publishes data with a one-day delay, so today the last available day is {ultimo_utile}.

portale_non_raggiungibile.message: Home Assistant cannot reach E-Distribuzione to renew access ({errore}). Check the internet connection; the integration retries on its own at the next update.

app_bloccata.message: E-Distribuzione is rejecting the official app's client the integration uses to sign in ("app_blocked" answer), so access cannot be renewed. It does not depend on your credentials: the integration retries on its own every hour.

accesso_scaduto.message: Access to E-Distribuzione has expired or was revoked (for example after a password change). Sign in again from the notice in Settings > Devices & services: PODs, options and history are kept.

accesso_bloccato.title: E-Distribuzione is blocking automated access
accesso_bloccato.description: E-Distribuzione answers with an anti-bot check instead of renewing access, so consumption data does not update. It does not depend on your setup or credentials, and the data already imported is kept. You can restore access right away by signing in again from the browser; otherwise the integration retries on its own every hour and this notice disappears as soon as access is available again. Do not remove the integration to set it up again.

confirm.title: Sign in to E-Distribuzione again
confirm.description:
E-Distribuzione answers with an anti-bot check instead of renewing access, so consumption data does not update. It does not depend on your setup or credentials, and the data already imported is kept.

To restore access right away, submit: the sign-in request shows in Settings > Devices & services, where you can sign in from the browser. If you prefer to wait, close this window: the integration retries on its own every hour. Do not remove the integration to set it up again.

app_bloccata.title: E-Distribuzione is refusing the integration's access
app_bloccata.description: E-Distribuzione answers "app_blocked" when access is renewed: one of its security rules is rejecting the official app's client the integration uses. It does not depend on your setup or credentials, and the data already imported is kept. You can restore access right away by signing in again from the browser; otherwise the integration retries on its own every hour and this notice disappears as soon as access is available again. Do not remove the integration to set it up again.

confirm.title: Sign in to E-Distribuzione again
confirm.description:
E-Distribuzione answers "app_blocked" when access is renewed: one of its security rules is rejecting the official app's client the integration uses. It does not depend on your setup or credentials, and the data already imported is kept.

To restore access right away, submit: the sign-in request shows in Settings > Devices & services, where you can sign in from the browser. If you prefer to wait, close this window: the integration retries on its own every hour. Do not remove the integration to set it up again.
